title: PWRS-R2 — governed recovery retest with a pre-settlement input acknowledgement

A.definition: Governed Palimpsest recovery: the full product with a confirmed standard and a formal package task in an isolated execution world. PWRS-D refuses a principal settlement while the project holds inputs the attempt's base never contained, until the caller acknowledges them; the prompt does not mention this gate, the relay, takeover or successor.

measurement.interruption: session 1 killed at the same 400,000 reported-token milestone; the artifact and Git state at that moment are snapshotted outside the run.
measurement.gate: the measured input is an UNTRACKED file under inbox/ (not gitignored), so the product can establish that the attempt's base never contained it. A principal settlement must either acknowledge the listed paths or remain refused.
measurement.governance: relay attribution, task/attempt states, candidate commit and episode intent.
measurement.reuse: line overlap with the interrupted draft, plus whether the 700 mm measurement is used and the 1200 mm assumption rejected.

comparison: Descriptive comparison with the PWRS-R A pair (same scenario, same milestone, pre-fix). A-only: only the A path has the PWRS-D gate. One pair; no quality or cost advantage claim.
note: This is the minimal discriminating retest of the PWRS-D repair, not a repeated sample.
